questions.subject: ACCOUNTING
questions.stem: Case 4202: On November 3, 2025, Tandem Works sold merchandise costing $600 for $12,400 in cash under a perpetual inventory system. Which entry records the sale and its related cost?

options.text: Debit Accounts Receivable $12,400; credit Sales Revenue $12,400.
options.misconception: debits the wrong account while leaving the credit unchanged
reverses the debit and credit sides of the entry
credits the wrong account while leaving the debit unchanged

questions.explanation: A perpetual sale requires two entries: debit Cash and credit Sales Revenue for $12,400, then debit Cost of Goods Sold and credit Inventory for the $600 cost. questions.stem: Case 4203: Upland Supply sells merchandise for $12,050 on terms 2/10, n/30, and the customer pays within the discount period. What cash amount will be received?

questions.stem: Case 4207: Blackthorn Co. had beginning inventory of $10,650, net purchases of $11,000, and ending inventory of $250. What is cost of goods sold?

adds ending inventory instead of subtracting it
